Title: New two-metric theory of gravity with prior geometry
Abstract: A Lagrangian-based metric theory of gravity is developed with three adjustable constants and two tensor fields, one of which is a nondynamic 'flat space metric' eta. Title: The generation of gravitational waves.  1. Weak-field sources:  A plug-in-and-grind formalism
Abstract: A plug-in-and-grind formalism is derived for calculating the gravitational waves emitted by any system with weak internal gravitational fields.
